children: NioCorp entered a 15-year offtake and marketing agreement with Traxys North America covering ferroniobium and other Elk Creek products, while terminating and replacing its prior 2016 ferroniobium offtake. The new deal includes a take-or-pay commitment for 50% of ferroniobium output or, at Traxys’ option, 3,700 metric tonnes per year, and grants Traxys exclusive rights to market scandium, titanium, and rare earth products. Pricing references market indices with specified discounts, commissions, and reimbursable costs. The move consolidates sales under a single long-term framework starting at commercial production.
: Offtake and exclusive marketing agreement for ferroniobium and other products
: 15 years from Commercial Production Date, plus two 1-year renewals
: Secure long-term sales and marketing for Elk Creek products
: Replaced by new comprehensive offtake and marketing agreement
